description: This file implements the core processing functions of an HTTP transaction record object within a proxy system. It defines functions for handling client requests, including querying for processing mode, receiving data, handling client disconnects, sending responses, and resuming transaction states. The code interacts with buffer descriptors, request/response objects, and socket connections to facilitate HTTP message handling and transaction control.

methods.name: ULONG HttpTroQueryForClient(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize,ANSC_HANDLE hBufferContext)
methods.description: Determines the processing mode for incoming buffer data based on the current message or connection state, deciding whether to forward, collect, or process the data.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpTroRecvFromClient(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize,ANSC_HANDLE hBufferContext)
methods.description: Processes data received from the client by passing it to the request object for examination and state update.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpTroFinishedByClient(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize,ANSC_HANDLE hBufferContext)
methods.description: Handles client connection closure, finalizes the request processing, and frees buffer descriptors if the request is complete.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpTroSendToClient(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hMessage,ULONG ulSendFlags)
methods.description: Sends response messages to the client, including headers and body, through the associated socket.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpTroResumeTransaction(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hReserved,ULONG ulSbcPmode)
methods.description: Resumes an HTTP transaction, possibly by establishing or re-establishing server connections, and sets the appropriate message exchange mode based on SBC (Server Behavior Controller) processing modes.
